shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents an edge on the back of the cube, hidden in the solid view. Right image: It marks the partition of the square into the pieces used to form the rectangle.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashes partition the square in a before-and-after piece rearrangement diagram. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
